---
title: "Module 08 — Multiple Pico identities"
---

## Idea

```
same code + different identity = different Pico
```

```
hello-pico/alice   event_count = 7
hello-pico/bob     event_count = 2
hello-pico/charlie event_count = 15
```

## Exercise

```python
rt = DurableRuntime("/tmp/multi.db")
for _ in range(7):
    rt.invoke("alice", "hello", {"name": "Alice"})
for _ in range(2):
    rt.invoke("bob", "hello", {"name": "Bob"})
rt.close()

rt2 = DurableRuntime.reopen("/tmp/multi.db")
assert rt2.inspect("alice").event_count == 7
assert rt2.inspect("bob").event_count == 2
```

Isolation + persistence after restart is required.
